messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- The billing API has a deploy freeze from 2025-11-24 to 2025-12-02, during the peak season. [constraint; valid 2025-11-11 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-11-11]
- On 2025-06-09, Oskar wrote the handover doc for the billing API for Lena. [valid 2025-06-09 to now; recorded by handover/2025-06-09-billing-api]
- The billing API depends on the ledger service for invoice postings. [valid 2025-01-09 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-09-2]
- The billing API only ships on weekdays after 15:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-02-11 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-02-11]

    earlier: The Atlas team owns the billing API as of 2025-06-09, when ownership passed from the Ember team; the Boreal team was recorded by mistake and never held it. [decision; valid 2025-07-03 to 2026-01-12; recorded by handover/2025-07-03-billing-api-correction]
    earlier: The Boreal team owns the billing API as of 2025-06-09, when ownership passed from the Ember team. [decision; valid 2025-06-09 to 2025-07-03; recorded by handover/2025-06-09-billing-api]
    earlier: The Ember team owns the billing API as of 2025-03-07, when ownership passed from the Atlas team. [decision; valid 2025-03-07 to 2025-06-09; recorded by handover/2025-03-07-billing-api]
    earlier: The billing API is owned by the Atlas team. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-03-07; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08-2]
- As of 2025-09-30, the billing API depends on the feature flag service. [valid 2025-09-30 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-09-30]

- Changes to the billing API need a rollback plan attached to the pull request. [constraint; valid 2025-04-02 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-04-02]
- On 2025-11-04, the Ember team observed that the billing API's queue depth hit 50,000 following the marketing send, and since it was not their service, they flagged it. [valid 2025-11-04 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-11-04]
- As of 2026-01-22, the product catalog deploy window remains weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays. [constraint; valid 2026-01-22 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-01-22]
- The Boreal team observed on 2025-12-01 that the billing API's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump. [valid 2025-12-01 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-12-01]
